standing: Documentation only. No generator modified, no PowerPoint regenerated, no component propagated, no screen/state map produced, no canonical P# minted. B02-CAIR-INT-001 remains open and still blocks canonical freeze, production approval and MMD build.

status_classes.CONFIRMED_CAIR_ADOPTION: Adopted from S&G v0.3 or inferred from a Bariah scoping qualifier; not attributable to a Bariah comment in her own words.
status_classes.PENDING_SOURCE_VERIFICATION: Ruling is clear but rests on a factual claim not yet traced to the module source.

decisions.title: Struktur Taman learning flow retained
decisions.ruling: The Struktur Taman flow built in v0.3 is approved unchanged: group master with four component cards -> component main explanation -> Contoh [Nama Komponen] example list -> example popup -> all-viewed state -> Kembali to the Struktur Taman group master. Popup density for Struktur Persisir Air is also approved. Amendments inside Family S are presentational only and do not alter the flow.
decisions.evidence: Guide item 4: 'Struktur Taman - Lulus'. Guide item 3: 'Struktur Persisir Air - Lulus'.
supersedes_or_resolves: B02-R-5 (Kembali semantics) — confirmed for Family S
decisions.generator_change_required: none for flow; presentational changes only

decisions.title: Perabot Taman gateway becomes a non-interactive overview
decisions.ruling: The Perabot Taman group master ceases to be a clickable interaction level. It becomes an overview plus a list of the five components, with no click and no level of its own. Learners enter each Perabot component through shell navigation, not by clicking a card.
decisions.evidence: Slide 43 inline directive: 'New structure. Refer doc Panduan_Semakan_Bariah_K5_PL06_T03_B02_v0.3'. Guide item 1: 'Perabot Taman - penerangan + list contoh (tiada klik/level)'.
supersedes_or_resolves: B02-R-3 — group-master completion no longer applies to Perabot
decisions.generator_change_required: model + generator: Perabot master becomes a non-interactive screen

decisions.title: Perabot components split into execution families P1 and P2
decisions.ruling: FAMILY P1 (multi-example perabot) = Kerusi Taman, Tong Sampah, Drinking Fountain: component explanation + example list -> click example (Level 1) -> full-slide example detail -> specification items -> click specification (Level 2) -> popup -> close icon returns to the example detail; Kembali returns to the component explanation/list. FAMILY P2 (specification-direct perabot) = Papan Tanda, BBQ Pit: component explanation + specification-category list -> click specification category (Level 1) -> popup -> close icon returns to the specification list. There is NO generic one-item Contoh screen for Papan Tanda or BBQ Pit.
decisions.evidence: Guide item 1 verbatim: 'Kerusi Taman - penerangan + list contoh: Kerusi Kayu Keras / Konkrit / Komposit (klik contoh - level 1, full slide, Kembali) / ... list spesifikasi (klik spesifikasi - level 2, pop up, butang tutup guna ikon) / Papan Tanda - penerangan + list spesifikasi: Bahan Panel / Bahan Struktur Tiang / Grafik / Rekaan (klik spesifikasi - level 1, pop up, butang tutup guna ikon) / Tong Sampah, Drinking Fountain - sama struktur dengan Kerusi Taman / BBQ Pit - sama struktur dengan Papan Tanda'.
supersedes_or_resolves: B02-A-05 (single-row source tables) — RESOLVED: split into interaction categories, source rows unchanged
B02-R-3 — MAX_LEARNER_NAVIGATION_DEPTH amended from 2 to 3 for Family P1
decisions.open_dependency: U-04 — BBQ Pit specification-category labels are not enumerated in the feedback and must be derived from source-attested substructure
decisions.generator_change_required: model + generator: two new Perabot families

decisions.title: Shell navigation replaces the duplicate learner-canvas Seterusnya
decisions.ruling: No custom Seterusnya button is authored on the learner canvas. The next control belongs to the LMS shell navigation. Completion gating semantics are preserved but are applied to the shell control (player_next_enabled = group_complete[group]) rather than to a control drawn in the deck. Off-canvas production metadata must stop describing a canvas Seterusnya.
decisions.evidence: Slide 8 inline directive verbatim: 'Tidak perlu letak butang Seterusnya, kerana ia ialah butang di navigasi'.
decisions.governance_concern: G-7 — the gate survives but the gated control is no longer authored in the deck

decisions.title: Contextual return controls: Kembali targets and the popup close icon
decisions.ruling: Return controls are contextual to the execution family. Kembali: Family S returns to the Struktur Taman group master from the example screen; Family P1 returns from the full-slide example detail to the component explanation/example list. Popup close: the control is an ICON, never a text 'Tutup' button, and it returns to the screen that owns the popup — the example screen in Family S, the full-slide example detail in Family P1, the specification list in Family P2.
decisions.evidence: Guide item 1: 'butang tutup guna ikon' (stated twice, once per Perabot family). S&G v0.3 restates the icon rule. Corroborated in A1 by ppt/media/image1.png, a real embedded image part referenced by slide 14 alone — the corrected popup exemplar.
supersedes_or_resolves: B02-R-5 (Kembali semantics) — amended: the return target is family-specific
decisions.generator_change_required: popup emitter + close-icon asset; per-family return targets in the model

decisions.title: Speaker Notes production headers restored on content and VO slides
decisions.ruling: On content and VO slides, Speaker Notes open with the course title where applicable, the PL title and the Topic/Bahagian title, then a blank line, then the screen or group context, then the exact VO or dialogue transcript.
decisions.evidence: Verified in every corrected exemplar in A1 (slides 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 43, 71, 73, 75). S&G v0.3: 'Production-context headers + exact VO/transcript on content slides'.

decisions.title: Silent completion-state Notes remain genuinely empty
decisions.authority: CAIR adoption of Bariah's 'where applicable' qualifier
decisions.ruling: Completion and all-viewed states carry no VO and therefore carry NO Speaker Notes at all — not even the production header block introduced by B02-D-06. The header rule applies to content and VO slides only.
decisions.evidence: Slide 20 inline directive: 'Apply changes to others, where applicable.' The corrected exemplar at slide 20 has empty Notes while every content exemplar has a header block — the qualifier is what scopes the header rule off silent states.
decisions.generator_change_required: completion-state builder must not emit headers
decisions.note: Classified CONFIRMED_CAIR_ADOPTION rather than CONFIRMED_BARIAH because the exclusion is inferred from the scoping qualifier plus the exemplar's own empty Notes, not stated as a rule in Bariah's words.

decisions.title: English-origin terms italicised on the learner canvas and in Speaker Notes
decisions.ruling: Approved English-origin terms are italicised consistently on the learner canvas AND in Speaker Notes, across every slide. This replaces the v0.3 practice of italicising only a closed three-term lexicon on the canvas.
decisions.evidence: Guide item 5, 'Cadangan ayat Rumusan' cell, verbatim: 'GLOBAL di speaker notes untuk semua slide. English words in italic'. S&G v0.3: 'Approved English-origin terms MUST be italicised consistently on the learner canvas and in Speaker Notes.'
decisions.note: The rule was written into the Rumusan suggestion cell but is explicitly global ('untuk semua slide'), so it is registered as a course-wide styling decision, not a Rumusan decision.

decisions.title: Rumusan wording approved
decisions.ruling: The Rumusan wording passes review. The canvas is retained as built. The only amendment is removal of the redundant opening label 'Komponen Landskap - Struktur Taman dan Perabot Taman.' from the narrated VO paragraph, and the addition of a 'Rumusan' context heading in Notes.
decisions.evidence: Guide item 5: box ticked, 'LULUS wording sesuai'. Verified on corrected exemplar slide 71: the Notes VO begins at 'Mengenal pasti...', not at the label.

decisions.title: Course-wide PL06 character naming policy confirmed; names not supplied
decisions.ruling: Named characters are to be used across the whole of PL06, reusing the same names wherever appropriate rather than inventing per-bahagian casts. The concrete names were NOT supplied. Until they are, the storyboard carries the placeholder token [Nama] and the role labels [Pelatih] / [Penyelia Tapak]. No name may be invented.
decisions.evidence: Guide item 6 answer cell verbatim: 'Gunakan nama watak untuk keseluruhan PL06. Gunakan nama watak yang sama bergantung kepada kesesuaian.' No A/B/C option box was ticked; the written answer is the decision. The corrected exemplar at slide 4 uses 'Encik [Nama]' — a placeholder, not a name.
decisions.generator_change_required: none until names are supplied; emit [Nama] meanwhile

decisions.title: Quiz entry control and knowledge-check framing
decisions.ruling: The quiz screen carries an explicit statement that it is a knowledge check only, a learner instruction, and a MULA KUIZ control that precedes Soalan 1. A result state reports the score with Lulus / Tidak Lulus. Semak Jawapan and Ulang Kuiz are retained. Source references gain subsection locators.
decisions.evidence: Verified directly on corrected exemplar slide 73: the MULA KUIZ instruction and the knowledge-check statement are both present on canvas.
supersedes_or_resolves: B02-R-4 (closing structure) — quiz remains non-blocking; entry control added

decisions.title: Multiple Response options carry no A/B/C labels
decisions.ruling: The Multiple Response item (Soalan 5) displays option text only. No A/B/C/D letter labels are shown on any option.
decisions.evidence: Verified directly on corrected exemplar slide 73: Soalan 5 option lines carry no letter prefixes, where the v0.3 original at slide 72 did.

decisions.title: Immediate feedback is concise correct/wrong confirmation
decisions.ruling: Immediate per-item feedback is a concise confirmation that the chosen answer is correct or incorrect. The long 'Maklum balas betul:/salah:' rationale paragraphs of v0.3 are removed from immediate feedback.
decisions.evidence: Corrected exemplar slide 73 removes the v0.3 rationale lines (Notes 3006 -> 1581 characters). The replacement wording 'Pilihan jawapan tepat' / 'tidak tepat' appears in S&G v0.3 and in NEITHER the annotated deck nor the review guide — so the ruling is adopted from the consolidated S&G, not attributed to a Bariah comment.
decisions.open_dependency: U-05 — where the detailed rationale lives once immediate feedback is concise (presumed Semak Jawapan, not confirmed)

decisions.title: Logical next destination is the next Bahagian in Topik 3
decisions.ruling: On completing this Bahagian, the logical next destination is the next Bahagian within Topik 3 — not the next Topik and not a course menu. The Tamat screen carries the heading 'Tamat Topik 3 Bahagian 2: Komponen Landskap' with the course and PL hierarchy on canvas.
decisions.evidence: Guide item 7: option A ticked — 'Bahagian seterusnya dalam Topik 3'. Wording cell: 'Refer storyboard'. Verified on corrected exemplar slide 75.

decisions.title: Physical LMS exit behaviour
decisions.ruling: Bariah's position: the shell navigation Seterusnya is DISABLED on the Tamat screen, and in the LMS the learner closes the lesson by closing the window. Bariah explicitly routed this to Firdaus for confirmation. It is NOT adopted as built until Firdaus answers.
decisions.evidence: Slide 75 inline directive verbatim: 'Butang Seterusnya di shell navigation DISABLED. Di LMS, learners perlu TUTUP lesson dengan tutup window. Firdaus, please confirm.'
decisions.open_dependency: U-03 — when completion is reported, where the LMS returns the learner, and whether the next Bahagian launches manually or automatically
decisions.generator_change_required: shell-control state on TAMAT — held pending confirmation
decisions.note: B02-D-14 (logical routing) is confirmed and independent of this entry. Only the physical exit mechanism is pending.
